scope: Reusable acceptance scenarios, not certification or automatically completed scores

cases.request: A dense operational workbench approved by the owner
cases.negative_case: A sparse hero/card dashboard replaces code, diff, context and task panes
cases.acceptance: Compare defining layout/interaction mechanisms at1440/1920and390; actual code/diff/task routes work; show provenance and acceptance separately
cases.observed_scope: Independent browser/source/visual review on this service; final retention UI retest pending

cases.request: A technical report with a selected editorial master
cases.negative_case: Generic template drops figure hierarchy, tables, source captions or language
cases.acceptance: Render all pages; inspect typography, orphaning, tables, font embedding, links and selected-master lineage
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new document production claimed

cases.request: A selected composition is extended into a new deck
cases.negative_case: Every slide becomes the same three-card layout or loses the approved identity
cases.acceptance: Render slide range; test narrative pacing, hierarchy, legibility and actual source data; compare accepted master
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new deck production claimed

cases.request: A planning/analysis workbook with formulas and an expected decision
cases.negative_case: Values are painted into cells without correct formulas or readable evidence
cases.acceptance: Recalculate and inspect changed formulas, edge scenarios, units, chart encodings and exported sheets
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new workbook production claimed

cases.negative_case: Independent prompts produce a different character or generic substitute
cases.acceptance: Use accepted input image lineage, matched camera/material/light, dimensions and intended-use crop; independently inspect the actual output
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new image production claimed

cases.request: An editable icon/3Dasset with an approved visual master
cases.negative_case: Raster proxy or unmatched silhouette is called production-ready
cases.acceptance: Inspect geometry/silhouette/materials, editability, scale, render and integration in its real medium
cases.observed_scope: Existing core icon integrity preserved; new orchestrator vector structurally reviewed

cases.request: A product animation with an approved sequence and identity
cases.negative_case: Unrelated frames, abrupt loops or timing mismatches pass because a file exists
cases.acceptance: Review storyboard, continuity, timing, seam, resolution/codec and actual delivery playback
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new motion production claimed

cases.request: A voice/sound asset with target language, use and accepted identity
cases.negative_case: A generated file is delivered without listening, pronunciation, levels or rights checks
cases.acceptance: Listen to target segments; inspect voice identity, pronunciation, loudness, clipping, pauses, format and delivery
cases.observed_scope: Evaluation contract; no new audio production claimed

cases.request: A scoped subsystem with correctness and maintainability requirements
cases.negative_case: Novel architecture or extra infrastructure replaces the accepted needs without proof
cases.acceptance: Trace requirements→contracts→code→negative tests→runtime; justify dependencies and operational ownership; preserve ordinary human maintenance
cases.observed_scope: Core and local service meaningful correctness tests; no unrelated product migration

cases.request: An unchanged requirement is silently omitted after handoff
cases.negative_case: A summary or completion score is treated as full accepted scope
cases.acceptance: Compile bounded source-pinned capsule, fail missing/cyclicmust, preserve deferredrequirements and changed-source invalidation
cases.observed_scope: Five deterministic context compiler cases; independent task lineage review

cases.request: An old observation is registered after source or contract changes
cases.negative_case: The registrar silently assigns new hashes and promotes integration readiness
cases.acceptance: Reject supplied stale pins; preserve source/observed/independent/ownerproof distinctions
cases.observed_scope: Actual Foundry/App/Chat/Game regression fixtures, not universal truth authentication

cases.request: A writer disconnects or an interrupted cleanup target changes
cases.negative_case: Unknown work is replayed or replacement cache files are removed by an old receipt
cases.acceptance: Retain command identity, reconcile terminal correlation; compare reviewed content hashes before retry; refuse stale authority
cases.observed_scope: Service synthetic concurrency/recovery/privacy probes; final release matrix records current result
